method: Browser computer use; 50 preset button activations and 20 newly authored custom inputs; simulated classifier-output camera labels; real local text inference, generator and quest callbacks. Repeated on repaired code; final targeted recheck of case 64 after last correction guard and fallback-label contrast patch.

ui_observation_latency_ms.scope: QA UI submission through completed visible output, including browser overhead; CPU text classifier, synthetic vision/fusion output, existing GPU generator. Not a webcam latency benchmark.

limitations: Development cases reused for fixes; not a held-out benchmark.
No actual camera frames; no MELD classifier/fusion accuracy claim.
Guard is a bounded heuristic, not a general semantic validator.
Guard buffers game replies before display and may make a second local generation call.
Synthetic fusion distribution is .88 on selected label and .02 on each other label; real text label retained for disagreement.
QA spawn is near Mara, stage resets use declared history fixtures, departure animation is held for inspection.
Neutral, surprise and disgust wording can still overlap; some replies remain generic.
